kamloops.title: Okanagan wine producers brace for U.S. ban on Canadian alcohol imports
kamloops.description: B.C. wine producers are bracing for the latest blow to cross-border alcohol sales, with the United States set to ban most Canadian alcohol imports later this month.

southeast.title: Residents of Kamloops neighbourhood raise safety concerns about proposed rail yard
southeast.description: The business arm of the Tk̓emlúps te Secwépemc community has asked the City of Kamloops to support a proposal for a rail staging and storage facility. But locals say they're already struggling with increasingly busy train crossings at the only points of access in and out of the community.
